mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM food_review WHERE food_id = #{foodId} AND audit_status = 1 AND status = 1

SELECT r.id, r.user_id AS userId, u.nickname, r.food_id AS foodId, r.score, r.content, r.like_count AS likeCount, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM food_review r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE r.food_id = #{foodId} AND r.audit_status = 1 AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
